properties.name: Glastonbury Tor
properties.description: Terraced hill linked to Avalon, the Isle of Apples from Arthurian legend. Said to be King Arthur's burial site and the entry to Annwn (Celtic Otherworld).

properties.name: Newgrange (Sí an Bhrú)
properties.description: Neolithic passage tomb older than the Pyramids. On winter solstice, sunlight illuminates the inner chamber through a roof box for 17 minutes.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, solstice lottery for visitors

properties.name: Stonehenge
properties.description: Neolithic stone circle aligned with solstices and equinoxes. Bluestones transported 240km from Wales. Associated with Merlin legends.
